benchmark.methodology: Online backup of validated SCIP facts. Setup deterministically reshards existing immutable claims into <=2000-claim owners with identical context/fingerprint and copied physical inputs/selectors; no fact/support/provenance is altered. This is a storage workload, not a claim that the original provider can reindex those shards. Original ownership and reshaped ownership both receive a complete first publication from empty projections with the current physical schema. Complete first publication and 3 serial replacements each of 1/10/100 full shards use the production publisher, WAL/FULL, all indexes, support checks and commit. Replacements validate every fact through addFact under a changed synthetic input fingerprint; staging/seal time is reported separately. No pointer-only timing, cache eviction or compiler/LOC claim. Full ownership EXCEPT oracles and pinned history are checked outside timing. High-fanout supports use synthetic derived dependency facts and alternate proofs. Source bytes remain unchanged. Initial snapshot/projection setup explicitly releases pins only in the disposable copy; production retention and the preserved pre-upgrade archive are unchanged. Required storage migration/rollback preparation is separately recorded before timing, as schema initialization previously was; no required publication work is excluded.

storageDefinition.name: sc_call_epochs
storageDefinition.sql: CREATE TABLE sc_call_epochs(caller INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sc_entities(id),callee INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sc_entities(id),first INTEGER NOT NULL,last INTEGER,site_count INTEGER NOT NULL,confidence TEXT NOT NULL,sample_claim INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sc_claims(id),PRIMARY KEY(caller,callee,first),CHECK(last IS NULL OR last>first))

storageDefinition.name: sc_claim_navigation
storageDefinition.sql: CREATE TABLE sc_claim_navigation(claim INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES sc_claims(id),relation TEXT NOT NULL,subject INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sc_entities(id),object INTEGER REFERENCES sc_entities(id),occurrence INTEGER REFERENCES sc_occurrences(entity),confidence TEXT NOT NULL,context TEXT)

storageDefinition.name: sc_visibility
storageDefinition.sql: CREATE TABLE sc_visibility(claim INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sc_claims(id),first INTEGER NOT NULL,last INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(claim,first),CHECK(last IS NULL OR last>first))

acceptance.correctness: All complete ownership EXCEPT, historical, alternative/last support, source-byte, integrity and FK checks pass. FULL/WAL and foreign keys remain enabled.
acceptance.originalUniversalOneSecond: Unmet: 21.930721 seconds for complete reshaped first publication, including 19.031120 seconds navigation.
acceptance.revisedPinnedAcWorkloads: Observed passing first <=30s / no-op <=100ms / <=10 full 2000-claim partitions <=1s / 100 such partitions <=3s / 100k dependency support closure <=1s. Three trials per replacement, not p95.
acceptance.setup: Automatic pre-upgrade rollback protection took 191.278717 seconds before timing; it is explicit migration cost, not a steady-state or publication latency. Only disposable copied pins are explicitly released in the already-required empty-projection initialization; production/source/archive protection is unchanged.
acceptance.limits: Native/graph first builds and large rewrites remain above one second. Migration, staging, compilers, full legacy exports, OS cache and other machine activity are not hidden in a pointer-only claim. Earlier rejected/battery attempts remain retained. No runtime algorithm changed for these timings.
